name: Global
registration_steps: Visit your national electoral commission website or office
Provide proof of identity (national ID, passport, or birth certificate)
Provide proof of address (utility bill, government letter)
Verify your registration status before election day
voting_steps: Bring valid photo ID on election day
Arrive at the polling station during voting hours
Collect your ballot from election officials
Mark your ballot in a private voting booth
Receive your 'I Voted' stamp or sticker
notes: Specific country data not available. Showing general election guidance. Please verify with your national electoral authority.
